commodity_exposure: Oil, natural gas and NGL production price risk; most significant market risk exposure is pricing applicable to oil, natural gas and NGL production.
hedging_strategy: Periodically enter into financial commodity derivatives (collars, swaps, basis swaps) to hedge a portion of production against commodity price declines; not designated as hedging instruments for accounting purposes.
governance: A committee consisting of members of senior management oversees commodity price risk management activities.
counterparty_risk: If counterparties default, protection from derivatives might be limited as the company might not receive the full benefit. Counterparties are primarily commercial banks and financial service institutions.
